findings.title: Cointegration-based pairs trading: ETFs (2025)
findings.summary: Tests pairs trading on ETFs 2000-2024. Systematic framework for ETF pair identification and cointegration stability cycles.
findings.reason_not_staged: ETF pairs already exhausted in H152-H160. Stock-level pairs exhausted (H200 NOT CONFIRMED). New approach needed (LLM-based pair selection), not incremental ETF variation.

findings.title: Which Voices Move Markets? Speaker Identity and Post-Earnings Returns
findings.summary: FinBERT on 6.5M sentences from 16.4K S&P 500 earnings calls (2015-2025), weighted by speaker role (CEO vs analyst). Monthly L/S alpha 2.03%, OOS Spearman IC 0.142.

findings.title: Advanced Deep Learning for Earnings Call Transcripts
findings.summary: Comparative BERT/FinBERT/ULMFiT analysis on earnings sentiment. Validates FinBERT foundation; no novel signal reported.
findings.reason_not_staged: Methodological validation only; no incremental signal over existing H174 FinBERT approach.

findings.title: Not All Factors Crowd Equally: Alpha Decay Modeling
findings.summary: Hyperbolic decay function for factor alpha across Fama-French factors (1963-2024). Momentum exhibits sharp decay; testable decay patterns by factor type.

findings.title: Drift Regimes Unlock Cross-Sectional Predictability (13-Sharpe OOS factor)
findings.summary: Value+reversal combo gated on statistical drift regime detection achieves OOS Sharpe 13+ in paper's universe. Drift regime: t-stat of rolling OLS slope > 2.0 AND volume confirming.
findings.caution: 13+ Sharpe implausibly high; treat as design inspiration, not benchmark

findings.title: TradingAgents: Multi-Agent LLM Financial Trading Framework
findings.summary: Role-based agent framework with fundamental, sentiment, technical analyst agents + risk team for stock selection.
findings.reason_not_staged: Already noted in ml-for-trading.md (2026-05-26). No new actionable finding.

findings.title: Signal or Noise in Multi-Agent LLM Stock Recommendations
findings.summary: Multi-agent LLM recommendations (S&P 500, Sep 2024-Mar 2026): sector drift noted, high noise-to-signal ratio. Cautions against pure LLM reliance.
findings.reason_not_staged: Confirms our existing stance: quantitative-first approach justified. No new strategy signal.

findings.title: QuantaAlpha: LLM-Driven Alpha Mining Framework
findings.summary: Evolutionary LLM framework auto-mines factors via trajectory mutation/crossover. Outperforms baselines on CSI 300 across regimes; Python 3.10 compatible.
findings.reason_not_staged: CSI 300 universe (Chinese stocks) — limited direct applicability to our US large-cap universe without retraining. Note for H222-full: could inform LLM-based factor mining approach. To revisit when H222-full (EDGAR XBRL quality factor) is active.

findings.title: earnings-sentiment: FinBERT + Loughran-McDonald pipeline
findings.summary: FinBERT + Loughran-McDonald on earnings transcripts; modest 1-day signal (rho≈0.3); easy yfinance integration.
findings.reason_not_staged: rho=0.3 is weak; Loughran-McDonald bag-of-words is less powerful than our existing FinBERT approach. H229 (speaker-role) is a stronger upgrade path.

summary: 3 proposals staged: H229 (speaker-role FinBERT on earnings calls with larger dataset, prerequisite: transcript coverage audit), H230 (alpha decay rebalancing optimization for H217), and a wiki update for regime-drift factor finding (design input for H165-full). Key theme: earnings NLP still has headroom (H229), and alpha signal decay modeling could unlock rebalancing gains (H230).
